text: {"lessons":["A falling account value alone is not a reason to trade; I should base decisions on my plan, not short-term swings.","My desire to avoid realizing losses can keep me holding a position for the wrong reason; I should assess each stock on its merits, not its average cost.","I should not sell winners merely to lock in a gain or buy back impulsively; with unpredictable prices, trade only when a deliberate portfolio decision calls for it."]}
